summary:
Our Project is all about a space mission and you have to build it. Your  world  earth is in very very bad condition. You and your best friend have to make your way through space  and  find a planet to live in. There will be space crafts, James Webb, rockets, meteors that will be in your way and planets. 
In the game you will use battery for your rocket to move. Travel by using MILES between planets and let your ADVENTURE BEGIN !
details: My project is a 2 people game that is very interactive. It has a lot of maths and science and strategy. My project is creative because it has a lot of interactive and awesome stuff that doesn't really shows itself in space.
